description: Defines the immutable StaffData class representing staff information in the Fineract project, including fields like id, name, office details, and role indicators.

classes.name: StaffData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing staff data with various constructors and static factory methods for different use cases.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a StaffData instance for import purposes with provided staff details.

methods.name: templateData
methods.description: Creates a StaffData object based on an existing staff object and allowed offices collection.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a StaffData object with only id and displayName for lookup purposes.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a fully populated StaffData object with detailed staff information.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the row index for import purposes.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the staff.

methods.name: getFirstname
methods.description: Returns the first name of the staff.

methods.name: getLastname
methods.description: Returns the last name of the staff.

methods.name: getOfficeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the office associated with the staff.

methods.name: getJoiningDate
methods.description: Returns the joining date of the staff.

methods.name: getOfficeId
methods.description: Returns the office ID associated with the staff.
